problem_text:
A courier must complete a sequence of visits to six distinct regional offices.

The travel times between offices are recorded in minutes:
* Office 1 to Office 2: 106.1 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 3: 47.2 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 4: 39.7 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 5: 53.8 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 6: 19.0 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 3: 140.4 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 4: 77.5 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 5: 145.2 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 6: 124.4 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 4: 63.1 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 5: 6.7 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 6: 33.5 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 5: 67.7 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 6: 53.5 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 6: 40.2 minutes

The objective is to determine the minimal-duration circuit that commences at a designated office, proceeds to each of the other offices precisely once, and finally concludes at the initial point of departure.
